sentences.en: Political power is conferred under a temporary and defeasible tenure.
sentences.zh: 政治权力是在一种临时且可撤销的占有期内授予的。

sentences.en: My brother just received tenure at the university where he teaches.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥刚刚在任教的大学获得了终身职位。

sentences.en: My professor didn't have tenure and was fired.
sentences.zh: 我的教授没有获得终身职位，被解雇了。
